claims.claim_text: stablecoin-pair (e.g. BUSD/USDT) market making returned ~29%/year unleveraged, 2021-early 2022
strategy has since decayed to ~10% unleveraged (implying it no longer clears leverage costs)
typical tick spread on these pairs ~0.0001 (1 bp per round trip)
major exchanges charge zero maker fees on stablecoin pairs regardless of fee tier
competition is 'queue time' rather than price/skill, because the minimum tick prevents spread compression below the tick
estimates ~1 fill/hour at peak, ~16 hours/day, 8 round trips/day, 8 bps/day, ~29.2%/year unleveraged (arithmetic, not compounded)
